name: Processor D
justification: The target four-spin TFIM ring requires interactions between qubits 0 and 1, 1 and 2, 2 and 3, and 3 and 0. A four-qubit ring directly supports all these bonds, reducing routing SWAP requirements compared with less suitable placements on the baseline processors. The CX-native gate set allows standard transpilation. We use single-qubit depolarizing error 0.001, two-qubit depolarizing error 0.005, and readout error 0.01. The design trades flexibility for low routing overhead and a minimal physical qubit count. Its actual performance will be established by the required benchmarks.
